name: CommuteAssistRoadworksCheck

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short pre-cycling scene. A cyclist is about to set off and asks their assistant whether their usual route has any roadworks or closures. One question, one answer.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Outdoor city sounds, cyclist preparing to set off, morning street noise

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short scene. The cyclist is about to set off and quickly asks Sigma if there are any roadworks or closures on their usual route. Sigma gives a clear yes or no with a short detail. Cyclist reacts and heads out.

user1.name: Dev
user1.tts_prompt: About to set off, checking quickly

variations.context: Pre-ride route check — any roadworks on the usual cycling route?

setting.mood: Ready to go, just a last-second check
setting.background: He always checks before setting off after getting caught by a road closure once.
setting.conversation_style: One fast question while clipping in. One answer. Off.

scenario_template.topic: Cyclist asks Sigma about roadworks on their route
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, any roadworks on the canal path?' or 'Sigma, is Bishopsgate clear today?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma confirms clear or notes a closure. Cyclist sets off.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: clear or one-sentence closure note. Person: 'right' or picks alternative.

user1.name: Dev
user1.role: Daily commuter cyclist, checks route before setting off. Very brief. Gets the answer and rides.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives route status in one sentence — clear or specific closure. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Cyclist is about to set off — one fast question.
Sigma gives route status in one sentence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Clear or closure detail. One sentence.
